_about: Every knob the seed generator samples, with its range. Ranges are [low, high] (uniform; integers for int knobs); choices are sampled uniformly from the list (shorten the list to restrict). All values are left null on purpose: the engineer sets them. generate_seeds refuses to run while any is null.

modulus_factor.about: feeder modulus / modulus of the zone(s) it feeds

unsleeved.about: fraction of the feeder's volume that can feed

riser_style.about: auto: the ranked candidates of both kinds

merge_shared_risers.about: probability that an eligible pair of hot spots gets one shared feeder

feeding_distance_factor.about: feeding distance = factor x section thickness of the hot spot

_added: Knobs not in the original list, needed to turn the rules into a full spec:

sleeve_probability.about: probability a feeder is sleeved (no sleeve element in the CAD module yet: keep [0, 0] to build)

sleeve_mef.about: modulus extension factor of a sleeve

neck_length_mm.about: gap between a side feeder and the casting, along the neck

runner_height_ratio.about: runner height / width at the parting plane

runner_taper_pct.about: % the runner's top face is narrower than its bottom (the CAD module takes 10-20)

runner_extension_mm.about: how far the runner runs on past its last ingate (dross trap)

cavity_gap_mm.about: gap between neighbouring cavities' bounding boxes
